Shipping Policy

Effective date: October 12, 2026

National Locks Supply sells and ships residential and commercial locks and door hardware to customers in the United States.

Standard shipping charges

For qualifying standard-size orders to the contiguous United States, shipping is $9 for merchandise subtotals under $100, and free for merchandise subtotals of $100 or more. The threshold is calculated before tax. Any shipping charge is shown in checkout before payment.

Special shipments

Oversized or unusually heavy commercial hardware and deliveries to Alaska, Hawaii, or other locations requiring special handling may need an individual quote. Please contact us before ordering if your shipment falls into these categories. Do not complete payment if checkout does not show the expected shipping arrangement.

Processing, delivery, and tracking

Processing and delivery times vary by item, stock availability, supplier, and destination. We do not guarantee a particular delivery date unless expressly confirmed when you order. Tracking details will be provided when available.

Damaged or missing shipments

Contact us promptly if an order arrives damaged, incorrect, or incomplete, and include the order number and photos where available. We will review the issue and provide next steps.

For returns, see our Return & Refund Policy.

Privacy Policy

Effective date: October 12, 2026

National Locks Supply uses customer information to operate our online storefront, respond to inquiries, process orders, arrange delivery, address returns, and provide customer support.

Information involved in an order

Information may include your name, contact information, billing and shipping details, purchased products, and messages you send us. Payments are handled through Stripe's hosted checkout; card payment information entered there is processed by Stripe under its own privacy practices.

Site technology and service providers

Our website and service providers may process technical information such as browser details, IP addresses, and usage data to operate, maintain, secure, and troubleshoot the store. We may share necessary information with payment processors, shipping carriers, fulfillment providers, and technical vendors to provide our services, subject to applicable law.

Retention and your choices

We retain information as needed for orders, customer support, legal obligations, and legitimate business recordkeeping. You may contact us to request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information, subject to applicable legal exceptions. For privacy questions, contact us using the number below.

Updates

This policy may be updated as our store and service providers change. The latest version will be posted on this website.
